steps.en: Officer decides to maintain the rejection
steps.why_en: No screen or option exists for this decision.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau pilihan untuk keputusan ini.

steps.en: The rejected record is left unchanged
steps.why_en: Nothing handles this decision; the record is untouched only because no logic exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menangani keputusan ini; record tidak berubah hanya karena logic-nya tidak ada.

steps.en: The record stays in the pool for court address checks
steps.id: Record tetap di pool pengecekan alamat court
steps.why_en: No pool or job for court address checks was found.
steps.why_id: Pool atau job pengecekan alamat court tidak ditemukan.
